title: Selective Keep Items
description: Select which items stay with players after death.
body:
Selective Keep Items lets you decide which items stay with players after death by defining them in a config file, giving you full control over what is preserved and what is lost.

This is useful for protecting important items, without changing normal death behavior for everything else.

Features:

  • Choose kept items in a config file
  • Lets the rest of the inventory drop normally

For example, you can keep valuable tools or armor, while still making death feel meaningful.
